# 盂蘭盆經讚述

**ID:** T2781
**Volume:** T85
**Category:** 經集部類,敦煌寫本部類
**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Byline:** 唐 慧淨撰
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 618–907
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2781

## Contributors
- 慧淨 (A001723)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T2781 in one fascicle is a Dunhuang-recovered early-Tang commentary on *[the Yúlánpén jīng 盂蘭盆經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0364)* (T685), preserved in the Dunhuang manuscript-cache and incorporated into the *Taishō Tripiṭaka* in vol. 85 (the *gǔyì* 古逸 / *miscellanea* volume). The commentary is attributed by Taishō to the early-Tang scholar-monk [慧淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B7%A8) (b. 578, fl. 605–650). It is the earliest known commentary on the *Yúlánpén jīng* — preceding *[宗密's Shū 疏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0365)* (T1792) by more than a century.

**Abstract**

The Taishō witness shows substantial textual damage at the head — a sequence of *kējì* 缺字 (missing-graph squares) — but the surviving body is sufficient to characterize the work. [慧淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B7%A8) reads the *Yúlánpén* in a primarily exegetical-rhetorical register: the genre of *zànshù* 讚述 ("eulogistic exposition") combines doctrinal commentary with rhythmic praise-prose, and the commentary works section-by-section through the sūtra. Notable points include [慧淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B7%A8)'s gloss on the etymology of *yúlánpén* ("即成食之器…奉佛施僧" — "a vessel for prepared food … offered to the Buddha and to the Saṅgha") and his treatment of Maudgalyāyana's vision of his hungry-ghost mother as a paradigmatic case of the doctrine of inherited karma. The text was lost from the mainstream canon in the Sòng and recovered only through the Dunhuang documents at the start of the twentieth century.

Composition window: [慧淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B7%A8)'s active scholarly period at the early-Tang capital, 627 (Zhēnguān 1, his entry into court patronage) – 650 (his last attested activity). No internal date is preserved.

Parent sūtra: [KR6i0364](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0364) (T685). Other commentaries on the same parent: [KR6i0365](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0365) (Zōngmì T1792), [KR6i0367](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0367)–[KR6i0373](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0373) (Sòng / Míng / Qīng commentary cluster).
